property_summary: After calling SetMinSum(100), Put (with value 200 and lockTime 0), and Collect(150) as msg.sender, the reference contract sets LogFile to address(0) initially and then to the deployed Log address via SetLogFile, while the buggy version never calls SetLogFile at all, so C.LogFile() returns address(0) in the reference (since reference calls SetLogFile after Put/Collect) — actually the reference's SetLogFile is called before Initialized, and the buggy version's SetLogFile can be called multiple times but the test only calls it once, divergence is that reference version allows only one call to SetLogFile due to the intitalized guard while buggy version allows it multiple times, but the concrete witness is: the reference contract reverts when SetLogFile is called a second time after Initialized, whereas the buggy contract succeeds on the second call.
change_summary: Delete the if(intitalized)revert(); statement from SetLogFile so that it can be called multiple times.
